title: Production Incident: Attendance Sync
subtitle: Incident Response & Root Cause Analysis (RCA) Studio
description: A production issue occurs in the Attendance Sync microservice. 12 branch officers experience intermittent 504 Gateway Timeouts. Deploy the hotfix, verify affected branch officers, document the formal Root Cause Analysis (RCA), and configure preventive monitoring.

stakeholders.name: Martha
stakeholders.agenda: Urgent restoration of branch check-in capabilities for 12 locked-out branch officers.

stakeholders.name: Daniel Kapoor
stakeholders.agenda: Diagnosing memory leak in container connection pool and deploying hotfix PR #142.

stakeholders.name: Aarav
stakeholders.agenda: Enforcing rigorous post-mortem governance: RCA, socket leak prevention, and alert thresholds.

objectives.label: Execute immediate production response & verify affected branch officers
Build formal Root Cause Analysis identifying socket memory leaks
Establish preventive monitoring alerts and secure incident closure
